gen-gf-revalia-fs-public-sans: Public Sans keeps a hefty, trustworthy lowercase with broad open counters, while Revalia strides in above it with widely separated, expressive letters. Make that heading small and it loses its swagger.
gen-gf-warnes-poppins: Poppins is modern and tidy, with tall, sturdy lowercase. Warnes sits over it with stretched, spacious tracking and tapered ink strokes, so the loud top and the quiet body each stay in their own lane.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-supreme: Commanding round forms like open parentheses give Goldman its stance, with generous clearance between each wide letter. And Supreme follows in a crisp, heavy-looking sans that keeps its letters held open.
gen-gf-grandstander-manrope: Chunky, bouncy, and full of nerve. Grandstander is the one for loud, tall-x-height shapes with short ascenders, while Manrope does its best work in quieter lines, with bright openings at every curve and a barely-there step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-fredoka-fs-chillax: Friendly is the first thing you notice in Fredoka, whose pen line holds one width and keeps its e open. Chillax follows with looser, spaghetti-like sans curves that stay relaxed where the heading stays crisp.
gen-gf-gugi-switzer: Switzer arrives with wire-like, tubular letterforms and a tall waist line, giving a Swiss, approachable feel. Gugi, up top, does its best work with lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, while Switzer holds the text with c tips that never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and unclamped, with a wire-like skeleton. Love Ya Like A Sister adds bold, expressive heading letters whose terminals point outward, keeping the page lively against that plain sans.
gen-gf-oxanium-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern and contemporary, with c tips that never creep toward touching and a mean line set high. Oxanium commands the heading with big-looking lowercase, while the body stays steady.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans brings a larger-than-usual x-height and s curves that open wide at both ends, with no thick-thin contrast anywhere. Paprika's scattered, capital-like lowercase takes the heading, leaving that plain sans the body.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-public-sans: Stencil bridges and tall lowercase make Snowburst One loud and instantly recognizable on top. And Public Sans carries on beneath with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, so paragraphs feel trustworthy and easy to settle into.
